text: Serbia has a few bollard designs, however most of them will have an **off-centred reflector.** The bollards are usually flat, with no depth to them.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞有幾種路樁設計，不過其中大部分都有一個**偏心的反光片**。路樁通常是平的，沒有什麼立體感。

text: Serbia uses **B-Profile** guardrails exclusively.
NOTE: North Macedonia does not use B-Profile guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/serbia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 塞爾維亞僅使用 **B-Profile** 護欄。
注意：北馬其頓不使用 B-Profile 護欄。若想大致了解歐洲護欄，請參閱[這張資訊圖表](/images/serbia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Serbia uses chevrons with a **black arrow** on a **white** background.
NOTE: Within Europe, these chevrons can also be found in Slovenia, Montenegro and North Macedonia.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞的轉彎標誌是在**白色**背景上有一個**黑色箭頭**。
注意：在歐洲境內，斯洛維尼亞、蒙特內哥羅和北馬其頓也能找到這種轉彎標誌。

text: Serbian licence plates are white with a **blue strip** on the left. Agricultural plates, on vehicles such as tractors, are **green**.
NOTE: Croatian and North Macedonian plates typically do not have a blue strip.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞車牌是白色的，左側帶有**藍色條紋**。農用車輛（如拖拉機）的車牌則是**綠色**的。
注意：克羅埃西亞和北馬其頓的車牌通常沒有藍色條紋。

text: Serbian is a Slavic language which uses both the **Cyrillic** and Latin script. These letters are unique to Serbian:
- Ђ ђ
- Ћ ћ
These letters are found in Serbian and Macedonian:
- Љ љ
- Њ њ
- Џ џ
text_zh: 塞爾維亞語是一種斯拉夫語言，同時使用**斯拉夫字母（Cyrillic）**與拉丁字母。以下這些字母是塞爾維亞語獨有的：
- Ђ ђ
- Ћ ћ
這些字母則同時見於塞爾維亞語和馬其頓語：
- Љ љ
- Њ њ
- Џ џ

text: When written in the **Latin** script, Serbian uses the special letters Č, Ć, Đ, Š and Ž. Note that all of these letters may also be found in Croatian and Montenegrin.
text_zh: 當使用**拉丁**字母書寫時，塞爾維亞語會使用特殊的字母 Č、Ć、Đ、Š 和 Ž。請注意，所有這些字母也可能出現在克羅埃西亞語和蒙特內哥羅語中。

text: Serbia has **4 different truck colours** that were used in different areas.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞有 **4 種不同的卡車顏色**，被用在不同的區域。

text: Serbia also has Generation 4 “smallcam” coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot. And a short antenna or black blur can be seen on the backside.
NOTE: Most of the Balkans also have Smallcam.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞也有第 4 代「小型相機（smallcam）」街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般的第 4 代低，且有一個相對大的圓形模糊，前方有一個小突起。這個模糊也可能是完全透明的，讓人比較難以察覺。背面還可以看到一根短天線或黑色模糊。
注意：巴爾幹半島的大部分地區也有小型相機街景。

text: Most of the generation 3 coverage in Serbia was taken by a Google car with **no antenna**.
NOTE: Other than North Macedonia, almost all of central and eastern Europe has antenna coverage in Generation 3.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞大部分的第 3 代街景覆蓋是由一台**沒有天線**的 Google 車所拍攝的。
注意：除了北馬其頓之外，幾乎整個中歐和東歐的第 3 代街景都有天線。

text: This is a generation 3 coverage map of Serbia. Most of the coverage is in the north in Vojvodina, around Belgrade and in the southeast around Niš. Kosovo does not have any coverage.
text_zh: 這是塞爾維亞的第 3 代街景覆蓋地圖。大部分的覆蓋都在北部的伏伊伏丁那（Vojvodina）、貝爾格勒周邊以及東南部的尼什（Niš）周邊。科索沃沒有任何街景覆蓋。

text: In the north of Serbia in the Vojvodina region, from the Hungarian border to Belgrade, the landscape is **extremely flat**, with no hills whatsoever. A slight ridge however can be seen at Fruška Gora National Park.

A more hilly landscape can be seen in the central-southern region. The most mountainous regions of Serbia are found in the southwest and southeast, where the Dinaric Alps, Carpathian and Balkan mountains run through Serbia.
text_zh: 在塞爾維亞北部的伏伊伏丁那地區，從匈牙利邊境到貝爾格勒一帶，地勢**極其平坦**，完全沒有任何丘陵。不過，在弗魯什卡戈拉國家公園（Fruška Gora National Park）可以看到微小的山脊。
在中南部地區可以看到較為丘陵起伏的地景。塞爾維亞最山多的一帶位於西南部和東南部，狄納爾阿爾卑斯山脈、喀爾巴阡山脈和巴爾幹山脈貫穿其中。

text: Serbia uses 2 digit area codes, with the first digit **between 1 and 3**. Area codes starting with 2 are found in the north, area codes starting with 1 are found in central and eastern Serbia. Area codes starting with 3 are found in the south-west.
text_zh: 塞爾維亞使用 2 位數的區碼，首位數字**介於 1 和 3 之間**。以 2 開頭的區碼見於北部，以 1 開頭的區碼見於中部和東部塞爾維亞。以 3 開頭的區碼則見於西南部。

text: Vojvodina, the northern region between the Hungarian border and Belgrade, can be recognized by the **flat**, **agricultural landscape**. The landscape will be completely flat with **no hills whatsoever**.
text_zh: 伏伊伏丁那（位於匈牙利邊境和貝爾格勒之間的北部地區）可以透過**平坦的農業地景**來辨識。地景將會完全平坦，**完全沒有任何丘陵**。

text: This slight **ridge** in an otherwise flat landscape can be seen in Fruška Gora National Park, southwest of Novi Sad.
text_zh: 諾維薩德（Novi Sad）西南方的弗魯什卡戈拉國家公園中，可以看到這種在平坦地景中突兀出現的微小**山脊**。

text: Central-northern Serbia can be recognized by the **slight rolling hills**.
text_zh: 中北部塞爾維亞可以透過**微微起伏的丘陵**來辨識。

text: A similarly rolling landscape can be seen in the southern Morava River basin, however **larger hills and mountains** can be seen.
text_zh: 在南摩拉瓦河（Morava River）流域也可以看到類似的起伏地景，不過能見到**較大的丘陵和山脈**。

text: A **lush**, **green**, **mountainous** landscape can be seen in the south and southeast, along the Bulgarian and Kosovo border.
text_zh: 在南部和東南部沿著保加利亞和科索沃邊境一帶，可以看到一片**蒼翠、綠意盎然的山區**地景。

text: Generation 3 **Fall coverage** can be seen in this region south of Čačak, and a small area around Valjevo.
text_zh: 在恰查克（Čačak）南方這個區域以及瓦列沃（Valjevo）周邊的小區域，可以看到第 3 代的**秋季街景覆蓋**。

text: A white Google Car with a **short antenna** can be seen in Novi Sad, Kovilj, in and around Belgrade, Niš, and the E75 connecting them.
NOTE: The white car is not always visible.
text_zh: 在諾維薩德、科維利（Kovilj）、貝爾格勒市區及周邊、尼什，以及連接它們的 E75 高速公路上，可以看到一台帶有**短天線**的白色 Google 車。
註：白色轎車不一定隨時看得到。

text: The distinct **Vršac Mountains** can be seen east of Vršac near the Romanian border. The mountains protrude out from a flat landscape and [vineyards](https://goo.gl/maps/e2hLdz6HJw4kWN778) can commonly be seen to the south of the mountains. The [Vršac Castle](https://goo.gl/maps/WzaCRBL14QdDEdre7) can also be seen atop the mountain.
text_zh: 在弗沙茨（Vršac）東側鄰近羅馬尼亞邊境處，可以看到獨特的**弗沙茨山脈（Vršac Mountains）**。這些山脈從平坦的地景中拔地而起，在山脈的南方常見到[葡萄園](https://goo.gl/maps/e2hLdz6HJw4kWN778)。山頂上也能看到[弗沙茨城堡（Vršac Castle）](https://goo.gl/maps/WzaCRBL14QdDEdre7)。

text: **Bilingual signs** with Serbian alongside Hungarian can be seen in northern Vojvodina, where there is a Hungarian majority.
text_zh: 在匈牙利族人口佔多數的北部伏伊伏丁那，可以看到並列塞爾維亞語與匈牙利語的**雙語標誌**。
